items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1957-04-11
items.q: I remember Sugar Underwood, yeah. Was he working with bands any, or was it just solo?

ctx.x: I was wondering if you knew any people around there, like, just blues piano players around Savannah and Jacksonville, like Sugar Underwood? Sugar Underwood, yeah, I remember him.
I remember Sugar Underwood, yeah. Was he working with bands any, or was it just solo?
